description: Stage-2d: autograd (reverse-mode AD) chi=3 MERA at the O'Brien-Fendley point. EXACT architecture from SIM-015d/036, gradient engine swapped from finite-difference to autograd (Cayley-transform unitaries, sparse-H primitive with H^T VJP, all verified vs finite-diff to ~1e-10). Ising control (lam3=0) validates the machinery; TCI (lam3=0.856) is the universality test. Gate: energy AND entanglement AND overlap.

results.verdict: TWO findings, stated precisely (the auto-generated 'collapses' wording is CORRECTED -- this is NOT a collapse). (1) ERRATA D5 FULLY VINDICATED: the SIM-036 product-state collapse (S_half 0.0002, ratio 0.001) was 100% an optimizer/objective artifact. With exact autograd gradients + the Z2-projected-energy objective, the SAME chi=3 architecture reaches S_half 0.1336 (ratio 0.745) -- a ~670x increase in captured entanglement -- at rel_err 0.088% and overlap 0.9943. The Ising control PASSES cleanly (rel 0.183%, ov 0.994, S_ratio 1.040) under the IDENTICAL protocol, validating the machinery, so this contrast is trustworthy. (2) chi=3 is SUFFICIENT for energy+overlap at the TCI point but reaches only ~74.5% of the true half-chain entanglement entropy -- the c=7/10 multicritical Schmidt tail exceeds a 3-dim bond. Because the optimizer is now definitively ruled out (control passed, exact gradients), chi=4 IS earned FOR THE FORCE READ-OUT SPECIFICALLY (the stress-tensor channel lives in the entanglement tail that chi=3 misses). This is a DIFFERENT, stronger basis than the retracted SIM-036 chi-4 call (which rested on a collapsed state + confounded optimizer). NEXT: chi=4 MERA at the TCI point (same autograd machinery, bond 3->4), then the force read-out. HYP-027 representability question = RESOLVED (chi=3 energy-faithful, entanglement-partial); universality alpha question = still OPEN, now on a sound chi=4 footing.

notes: Root-cause fix for the SIM-036/037/038 product-state collapse: exact gradients via autograd instead of finite differences on 1246 angles. Cayley transform replaces scipy.expm (no autograd VJP). The Ising control is the trust anchor; only a passing control makes the TCI verdict meaningful.
